title: Hebetate
summary: HEB'ETATE, verb transitive [Latin hebeto, from hebes, dull, blunt, heavy.] To dull; to blunt; to stupefy; as, to hebetate the intellectual faculties.

inlines.v: HEB'ETATE, verb transitive [Latin hebeto, from hebes, dull, blunt, heavy.] To dull; to blunt; to stupefy; as, to hebetate the intellectual faculties.
